LESSON: SINGING PERFORMANCE

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Singing PERFORMANCE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Singing PERFORMANCE. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Singing PERFORMANCE
2. Practise Singing PERFORMANCE at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Singing PERFORMANCE

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Singing PERFORMANCE
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Singing PERFORMANCE. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Singing PERFORMANCE at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Singing PERFORMANCE at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Singing PERFORMANCE
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Singing PERFORMANCE. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Singing PERFORMANCE using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Singing PERFORMANCE in the examples.
2. Explain Singing PERFORMANCE to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Singing PERFORMANCE.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Singing PERFORMANCE using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Singing PERFORMANCE important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
